Class NitriteEntityMapper

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.mapping.NitriteEntityMapper

Mapper for converting entities to Nitrite Documents and back.

      public NitriteEntityMapper(io.micronaut.core.convert.ConversionService conversionService, @Nullable @Nullable io.micronaut.serde.ObjectMapper serdeObjectMapper, io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.RuntimeEntityRegistry runtimeEntityRegistry)
      Create a new mapper.

      Architecture: This mapper uses Micronaut Serde only when an application provides a Serde ObjectMapper; otherwise it relies on ConversionService, BeanIntrospection, and plain JDK JavaBean reflection (see reflectToMap(Object)).

      Parameters:

      serdeObjectMapper - the optional Micronaut Serde ObjectMapper
      runtimeEntityRegistry - the runtime entity registry

    • getEntityIdValue

      @Nullable public <T> @Nullable Object getEntityIdValue(NitriteEntityMeta<T> meta, T entity)
      Extract the ID value from an entity using pre-computed metadata.

      An entity with a composite identity has no single id property to read, so the entity itself stands in for its identity: idEqualsFilter(NitriteEntityMeta, Object) reads the individual identity properties back off it. A composite identity is only an identity once every one of its properties is set, so a partially populated one reads as absent.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the entity type
      Parameters:
      meta - the pre-computed entity metadata
      entity - the entity instance
      Returns:
      the ID value, or null when the entity carries no complete identity

    • documentKeyFilterFor

      @Nullable public <E> @Nullable org.dizitart.no2.filters.Filter documentKeyFilterFor(io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.RuntimePersistentEntity<E> entity, org.dizitart.no2.filters.Filter filter)
      The document-key equality that answers a whole query filter, or null when that filter is not a bare identity equality.

      Applied to the complete filter rather than to each predicate as it is built, because the rewrite is only safe where a fallback is: a document stored under a key that is not its identity is matched by the identity field and not by the key, so the caller reruns the original filter when the rewritten one finds nothing. That retry is only well defined when the identity equality is the entire query. A predicate buried in a conjunction keeps the identity field, and with it the behaviour it had.

      Type Parameters:
      E - the entity type
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity being queried
      filter - the complete filter built for the query
      Returns:
      the document-key filter, or null when the query is not a bare identity equality

    • documentKeyEqualsFilter

      @Nullable public <E> @Nullable org.dizitart.no2.filters.Filter documentKeyEqualsFilter(io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.RuntimePersistentEntity<E> entity, String field, @Nullable @Nullable Object value)
      The document-key equality for a query predicate that compares an entity's identity field, or null when the predicate is not one, or when that identity is not the document key.

      A query reaches its predicates through the field name rather than through idEqualsFilter(NitriteEntityMeta, Object), so without this a derived findById, a @Query on the identity and a criteria equality on it would all filter on the "id" field. That field carries no index for a Long identity - the document key already being one - so the predicate would be answered by a collection scan while the same lookup issued through the entity operations is a single key seek.

      Like the filter the entity operations build, this matches only a document whose key is its identity. A document stored under any other key is not found by it. The write paths carry a fallback for that case; a read does not, and did not before this rewrite either, since findById has always filtered on the document key.

      Type Parameters:
      E - the entity type
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity being queried
      field - the persisted field name the predicate compares
      value - the value the predicate compares it against
      Returns:
      the document-key filter, or null when the predicate is not rewritable

    • fromDocument

      @Nullable public <T> T fromDocument(@Nullable @Nullable org.dizitart.no2.collection.Document doc, Class<T> type)
      Hydrate an entity from a Nitrite Document.

      Non-embedded single-valued associations stored as foreign keys are eagerly resolved while the document is mapped, including when the repository query does not declare @Join. Each root document has an independent hydration cache, so loading multiple roots can issue one additional collection lookup per to-one association per root and can recursively hydrate the referenced graph. Explicit join fetching is currently batched only for inverse ONE_TO_MANY/MANY_TO_MANY associations.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the entity type
      Parameters:
      doc - the Nitrite document
      type - the entity type
      Returns:
      the hydrated entity
